name: Terrain: generate, sculpt and walk on heightmap ground
body:
# Terrain

Heightmap ground for Lantern: generated from a seed, sculpted in the world editor, drawn and walked on in the game. Asked for by Dean on 2026-11-26 ("terrain generation and manipulation tools").

Design (D-266 to D-269): a terrain is an ordinary world entity of kind `terrain`, so the world file format does not change. Its size and heights live in `terrain_*` properties (the heights as 16-bit centimetres in hex). Code is `engine/src/world/terrain/`. The game gets the mesh and the static collision from `BuildPiece`, so the player and the companion walk on it with no new physics code.
